chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 588: Ji Ning Comprehends the Grand Dao of Waterdrop
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning achieves a breakthrough by contrasting Daofather Fuju's transcendent sword art with the Ninefold Chaos Seal, comprehending his second Grand Dao. A prince then makes a fatal mistake.
og_description: Our hero masters the Grand Dao of Waterdrop by decoding the cosmic secrets of a primordial sword-art. Plus, a prince picks a fight with the wrong immortal.
twitter_title: Epic Cultivation Insight + Classic Xianxia Showdown Setup!
twitter_description: Ji Ning unlocks his second Grand Dao by comparing Daofather Fuju’s divine swordplay to a chaos relic. Meanwhile, an arrogant prince chooses a victim – the worst possible choice.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary Sword Immortal from the primordial era whose sword art surpasses the limits of the Heavenly Daos of the Three Realms.
A natural, infinitely profound seal that manifests within the primordial chaos, described as patternless and endless like the mathematical constant pi.
A profound Grand Dao representing the cyclic, penetrating nature of water, one of the exalted powers a cultivator can comprehend.
A powerful mortal dynasty within a minor world of the Three Realms, ruled by a royal family with significant cultivation resources.
A talented but arrogant prince of the Eastluan Dynasty, a Primal Daoist who tries to bully Ji Ning.
